messages:
nora_eng: embeds-prod-eu started returning 503s and 5xx spikes at 14:05 UTC. Root cause: header-parser recursion under certain batched requests leading to kvcache eviction storms. I built hotfix image r7.4.3-hotfix and want to do expedited micro-canary (3%) due to traffic patterns. Requesting ops + sre approval.

deploy-bot: Deploy request created: service=embeds-prod-eu image=r7.4.3-hotfix requester=nora_eng. Default policy canary=10%. You requested canary=3%. Approvals required: 2 (ops, sre). Approve with `/approve deploy 2901234567` or react with :white_check_mark:.

ben_sre: Can we limit to 3% but require a 6m observation window. Also need a pre-deploy prometheus snapshot and a flamegraph link. Post those and confirm no DB migrations.

sam_ops: I can approve if rollback image is pinned and ops playbook link included. I'll take pager for 45m. Please include the quick rollback steps.

nora_eng: Prometheus snap: https://telemetry/internal/snaps/2901234567-pre. Flamegraph: https://telemetry/internal/flame/2901234567-pre. No DB changes. Rollback image r7.4.2-stable. Quick rollback: `deployctl rollback --service embeds-prod-eu --image r7.4.2-stable && deployctl wait --stable embeds-prod-eu`. Full runbook: https://playbooks/internal/embeds/rollback-2901234567.

lucy_pm: Product approves expedited micro-canary. Impact: intermittent failures for queued batch jobs in EU; medium severity. Recommend communicating to affected customers if deploy fails.

ben_sre: /approve deploy 2901234567  Approving on condition: canary=3%, observe=6m, and ops on pager.

sam_ops: /approve deploy 2901234567  Approved. Pager on for 45m, rollback command saved.

deploy-bot: Approvals received (2). Initiating controlled rollout: canary=3% -> monitor=6m -> promote. Command executed: `deployctl rollout start --service embeds-prod-eu --image r7.4.3-hotfix --canary 3 --timeout 6m --requester nora_eng`

deploy-bot: Canary pods created: embeds-r7-4-3-hotfix-canary-1 (Ready), embeds-r7-4-3-hotfix-canary-2 (Ready). Telemetry stream: https://telemetry/internal/embeds/2901234567-canary

deploy-bot: Canary metrics after 6m: errors=0, p99=435ms (baseline 430ms), kvcache misses returned to baseline. No anomalous traces. Proceeding with promotion per rollout policy.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Deployment status: SUCCESS. Release page: https://deployments.redwood/2901234567

nora_eng: Watching dashboards for 1h. If p50/p99 delta >20% or error-rate >0.3% I'll trigger rollback. Thanks all.

lucy_pm: Release note drafted and approved: "hotfix(embeds): fix header-parser recursion causing kvcache eviction -> intermittent 5xx (r7.4.3-hotfix)". Sending comms after 30m of stability.

sam_ops: No alerts so far. Standing by.

ben_sre: Added a transient regression alert for next 90m: p99 delta >25% OR errors>0.5%.

release-bot: Generated release notes URL: https://internal/releases/2901234567-edit :shipit:

nora_eng: closing thread in 60m if stable. Great teamwork :tada:
